name: How long does it take to install a new exterior door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new exterior door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a new exterior door typically takes a single day for a standard replacement. This can vary based on the specific type of door, the existing frame condition, and any unforeseen structural adjustments needed. For example, replacing a standard entry door usually involves removing the old door and frame, preparing the opening, installing the new pre-hung door unit, sealing, and finishing. More complex installations, such as those requiring significant frame modification or sidelights, may extend into a second day. We aim for efficient, precise installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard exterior door replacement typically takes one day. Complex installations or frame modifications might extend the process to two days.
